name: net_session_browser_dialog_validate_player_name
description: NetSessionBrowserDialog::ValidatePlayerName saves dialog data, trims the bound player-name CString, accepts non-empty names, and rejects empty names with a localized message and focus reset. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
MFC CWnd/CString provider calls are isolated through native smoke patches or linked MFC42 CString behavior.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41b6a0 validates the thiscall ABI, UpdateData(TRUE), CString TrimLeft and TrimRight on m_playerName at offset 0x1b0, UpdateData(FALSE), CString length check via m_pchData[-8], success return 1, and failure path using zLoc message ids 24 and 23 with MB_ICONHAND.

The native smoke verifies both the non-empty trimmed success path and the all-whitespace failure path, including UpdateData call order, localized MessageBoxA arguments, and SetFocus on m_playerNameEdit.
